title: Teamspaces
intro: Bring shared pages and their participants together within this workspace.
createHint: You will be its owner. Moving pages requires a separate review of the access changes.
empty: There are no teamspaces to display.
name: Name
confirmAccess: I have reviewed the changes to membership access and page permissions.
visibility_open: Workspace members can join from the directory. Page access applies after joining.
visibility_closed: Listed in the workspace directory. Eligible members can request to join; an owner must approve before page access is granted.
visibility_private: Hidden from the directory for nonmembers. Individual page sharing applies separately.
defaultPermissionHint: The permission granted through teamspace pages. Individual denials and permission inheritance still apply.
accessHint: This setting does not replace workspace roles or individual page sharing.
readOnly: Only teamspace owners can change these settings.
archivedHint: Archived teamspaces remain readable. Settings, member additions, role changes, and joining are paused until restored. You can still leave.
archivedReadonly: An owner must restore this teamspace before it can be changed.
memberRolesHint: These teamspace roles are managed separately from workspace roles.
membersHidden: The member list becomes available after joining.
noMembers: There are no members to display.
selfRemovalHint: The last owner cannot leave, be removed, or be demoted. Add another owner first if needed.
confirmLeaveMessage: You will lose permissions granted through this membership. Direct sharing on individual pages remains separate. Private teamspaces will also disappear from the directory.
confirmRoleMessage: Change {name}'s role to {role}. Review their access before continuing.
confirmRemoveMessage: Remove {name} from this teamspace. Direct permissions on individual pages remain separate.
confirmAddMessage: Add {name} as {role}. They will receive the default permission on pages placed in this teamspace.
archiveHint: Keep the pages while pausing teamspace changes and new membership.
unarchiveHint: Resume changes to settings and membership, and allow people to join.
confirmArchiveMessage: Keep the pages while pausing changes to this teamspace and new membership.
confirmUnarchiveMessage: Resume changes to settings and membership, and allow people to join.
discardMessage: Discard unsaved teamspace settings and membership selections.
unknownOutcome: The save result could not be confirmed. Reload to check the current state before sending another change.
accountChanged: The active account changed or could not be verified. Close this screen and check your account.
conflict: These settings changed. Reload and review the current values.
lastOwner: The last owner cannot be removed or demoted. Add another owner first.
forbidden: Your current permissions do not allow this teamspace to be displayed or changed.
tooLarge: A teamspace or membership limit was reached. Reduce the content and review it again.
invalidName: Enter a name of up to 100 characters containing at least one non-whitespace character.
invalidDescription: Enter a description of up to 1,000 characters.
unavailable: Teamspaces could not be loaded. Please reload and try again later.
refreshFailed: The change was saved. Reload to check the state before returning to the workspace.
localeFallbackNotice: Some labels use English. Page names and content are not translated.
duplicateHint: Copy the description, visibility and default permission into a new teamspace. Pages and members are excluded. You will be its only initial owner.
confirmDuplicate: I confirm the displayed visibility and default permission for a new teamspace without copied pages or members.
duplicated: Teamspace settings duplicated. Pages and members were excluded.
requestPending: Your request is awaiting an owner’s review.
requestAccessHint: Approval adds the person as a member with the current default permission: {permission}. Individual page permissions still apply. No email is sent.
requestDirtyHint: Save or discard your settings and membership selections before reviewing requests.
requestConfirm_request: Ask to join {name}. Page access starts after an owner approves the request. No email is sent.
requestConfirm_cancel: Cancel your pending request. You can request to join again later.
requestConfirm_approve: Add {name} as a member with the current default permission: {permission}. Individual page permissions still apply.
requestConfirm_reject: Decline {name}’s request. They can request to join again later.
requestApproved: Request approved. The person is now a member.
